tbesh_html:
1) to play or strike strings, play a stringed instrument
1a) (Qal)
1a1) player (participle)
1b) (Piel)
1b1) to play
1b1a) player, minstrel (participle)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, to thrum, i.e. beat atune with the fingers; expectation. to play on astringed instrument; hence (generally), to make music
strongs_1890.kjv_def: player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play(-er, -ing).
